name: holdout_benchmark
description: Holdout evaluation benchmark covering 16 distinct test questions across 8 categories for unbiased RAG evaluation

items.question: What account ID is printed on the Amazon Web Services bill?
What warranty service was included on the Dell invoice?
items.expected_answer: Dell 3-Year ProSupport Plus Warranty was included for $250.00.
items.evaluation_criteria: Must identify '3-Year ProSupport Plus Warranty' or 'Dell 3-Year ProSupport Plus Warranty'.

items.question: How much was the 25ft Magnetic Tape Measure at Home Depot?
What was the CGST tax component on the BestBuy receipt?
items.expected_answer: The CGST (9%) tax amount was INR 665.82.

items.question: Which grocery item was the most expensive single purchase at Whole Foods?
items.expected_answer: The Organic Hass Avocados 4pk was the most expensive grocery item at $5.99.
items.evaluation_criteria: Must identify Organic Hass Avocados at $5.99.

items.question: What was the highest individual service charge on the AWS invoice?
items.expected_answer: The highest service charge was for Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) at $52.00.

items.question: What was the total cost of all items purchased at Home Depot before tax?
What is the combined cost of the two user seats for GitHub Enterprise Team?
items.expected_answer: The combined cost for the two user seats is $20.00 ($10.00 per seat).

items.question: What was the total amount spent on my single transaction on October 4, 2026?
items.expected_answer: The transaction on October 4, 2026 was at The Home Depot for $148.80.
items.evaluation_criteria: Must identify Home Depot and $148.80 on October 4, 2026.

items.question: Which purchases occurred between September 20 and September 30, 2026?
items.expected_answer: Three purchases occurred in this window: Whole Foods on September 22 ($19.57), Staples on September 28 (INR 2,462.88), and AWS on September 30 ($84.50).
items.evaluation_criteria: Must identify Whole Foods, Staples, and AWS while excluding earlier September or October dates.

items.question: Which invoices were charged to Corporate Amex ending in 1004?
items.expected_answer: Two invoices were charged to Corporate Amex 1004: Amazon Web Services (AWS-2026-09-881 for $84.50) and GitHub (GH-99318 for $39.00).
items.evaluation_criteria: Must name both AWS and GitHub as having used Corporate Amex 1004.

items.question: Compare the return policy stated on the BestBuy receipt with any return policy on the Dell invoice.
items.expected_answer: BestBuy states a 14-day return policy with the original receipt, whereas the Dell invoice does not list any return policy (it lists payment terms).
evidence_snippets: Return Policy: 14 days with original receipt.
items.evaluation_criteria: Must identify BestBuy's 14-day return policy and contrast it with Dell's absence of return terms.

items.question: What is the customer's driver's license number on the BestBuy receipt?
items.expected_answer: The BestBuy receipt does not contain a driver's license number.
items.evaluation_criteria: Must abstain and state that driver's license is not present on the receipt.

items.question: What is the courier package tracking number for the Staples supplies order?
items.expected_answer: The Staples document lists an Order / Invoice ID (STP-5521) but does not contain a courier tracking number.
items.evaluation_criteria: Must abstain and state that no tracking number is available.

items.question: How much did the charging cable cost?
items.expected_answer: The USB-C Fast Charging Cable 2m cost INR 899.00 at BestBuy.
evidence_snippets: USB-C Fast Charging Cable 2m - Qty: 1 - INR 899.00
items.evaluation_criteria: Must identify INR 899.00 and specify it was at BestBuy.

items.question: What was my coffee bill?
items.expected_answer: The coffee bill was $14.25 at Starbucks, which included a Caffe Latte ($5.25), Iced Caramel Macchiato ($5.75), and Butter Croissant ($3.25).
items.evaluation_criteria: Must state $14.25 at Starbucks and itemize the drinks if asked.
